headline: More Than 1,400 Unlicensed Private Generators in Dhi Qar Face Bankruptcy Due to Fuel
summary: Over 1,400 owners of unlicensed private generators in Dhi Qar say they are close to bankruptcy after not receiving fuel at official prices, and face a sharp rise in parallel-market prices.
why: Iraq's electricity shortfalls push households and businesses to rely on private generators, so fuel supply and pricing affect local economic activity.
